items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: the drummers were Norman Sloane and Don De. Soto and a fellow named Leroy Judd

ctx.x: The trombone player was a man named Norris Hurley Hal Sloane, the drummers were Norman Sloane and Don De. Soto and a fellow named Leroy Judd. And the saxophone, Herb Stowe (Burt Stowe?). He was the grandson of Harriet Beecher Stowe.
